fact: On 29 May 2026 the CNIN recalled that using AI to alter, generate or spread a person's image without consent is prosecutable under article 576 of the Code du numérique, with up to five years in prison and a fine of 25 million FCFA.
title: Bénin : l'usage non autorisé de l'IA sur l'image d'autrui peut coûter 44 400 $ d'amende
